old.H3-P3: Get two or three people together to form a practice group. Call it that, not a commune! Meet regularly, and practice listening and switching roles, and get through at least one disagreement together, and keep your commitments to each other. One disagreement is enough, I promise! Hold off on talking about a shared future until you've done all of that.

H3-P3.h: Find two or three other people and meet regularly. This is not quite the same thing as forming a commune. Call it a practice group. Practice the skills you need to practice: listening, switching roles, handling one disagreement, keeping your commitments, etc. One disagreement is enough! You can talk about a shared future later.
H3-P3.b: Get a few people together, two or three, and start practicing together. Don't call it a commune, and you don't have to actually be a commune. Call it a practice group. Just get together regularly, and learn to listen, switch roles, handle one disagreement and keep your commitments. One disagreement is enough! You can talk about a shared future after that.
